mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_message ( room_id, sender_id, message, created_at, is_read ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{message}, NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, sender_id, message, created_at, is_read, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time FROM tb_chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
